implementation: independently authored indexer and read API for the PATINA protocol

consensusSurface.note: Vendored as a packed tarball committed to this repository, so the dependency resolves for anyone who clones this repository without also checking out the protocol repository at a matching relative path. scripts/verify-vendor.mjs recomputes SHA-256 and npm integrity, inspects the packed name/version/spec hash, and checks package and lockfile resolutions on every verify run.
provides: frozen constants and the reason code registry
identity derivations, reduced-data commit-leaf construction, permanent dual-format commit-leaf parsing, artifact id and attestation message
SEED and KEEP validation and the default successor rule
the deterministic state reducer applyBlock and replay
canonical event, artifact and state root encodings
deployment record loading and the founding window state machine

notes: No protocol logic is copied into this repository. The entire consensus surface available to this indexer comes only from the vendored @bitcoinuniverse/patina package named above; src/protocol.ts imports it and defines no rules of its own.
Every consensus decision is a call into @bitcoinuniverse/patina. src/protocol.ts is a re-export only and contains no rules.
src/facts.ts reads a block back through the same package to recover storage details the state model does not carry, such as which input revealed the commit leaf. It makes no judgements of its own.

src/store.ts recomputes aggregate counters when rebuilding a snapshot from SQL. The result is checked against the state root the reducer wrote for the tip block, so a disagreement stops the process instead of being served.
references: PATINA implementation baseline, frozen constants and contracts
